**Yes, you are eligible for Child Benefit for both Alex and Blake!**

Both of your children meet all the necessary criteria:
- They are both under 16 years old

- There are no disqualifying circumstances

- If you haven't already claimed, you can apply for Child Benefit
- Remember that only one person can claim Child Benefit for each child
- If you or your partner have an individual income over £60,000, you may need to pay the High Income Child Benefit tax charge, but you can still claim the benefit
